# Global Orators Project (GOP)
> Pan-African debate training, sovereign leadership development, and healing-centered vocal expression programs for African youth and executive orators.

## Core Programs
- [Academy Track](/academy): Competitive British Parliamentary and World Universities Debating Championship (WUDC) training, argumentation rigor, and oratorical forensics.
- [Foundation Track](/foundation): Healing-centered catharsis, emotional sovereign vocalization, community storytelling, and speech-as-escapism workshops.
- [Executive Track](/speaker): Boardroom pitching, Bottom Line Up Front (BLUF) synthesis, capital raise narration, and high-conviction keynote delivery.
- [Tournaments](/tournaments): Continental championships, regional varsity leagues, and adjudicator certification.
- [Testimonials](/testimonials): Verified orator dispatches, impact metrics, and alumni narratives.

## Faculties & Governance
- Head Coach: Qassim Musa, Faculty Director & Forensic Adjudicator
- Governance & Admissions: director@globalorators.org

## Application & Onboarding
- Self-Service Onboarding: [/apply](/apply)
- Dynamic Calibration: 4-step diagnostic evaluating vocal baseline pace (WPM), arena goals, and daily rituals.
